title: The Book of Titus Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of Titus — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God's elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;
verses.decoded: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, sent because of the faith that God’s chosen people have, and because they accept the truth that leads to godly living;

verses.kjv: But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching, which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour;
verses.decoded: At the right time, he made his message known through preaching, which was given to me by the command of God our Savior;

verses.kjv: To Titus, mine own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.
verses.decoded: To Titus, my true son in the faith we share: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.

verses.kjv: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee:
verses.decoded: I left you in Crete for this reason: to organize what still needs to be done and to appoint elders in every town, just as I told you to do.

verses.kjv: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.
verses.decoded: An elder must be blameless, married to only one wife, and have children who believe and are not accused of being wild or disobedient.

verses.kjv: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;
verses.decoded: An elder must be blameless, like God’s manager; not stubborn, not quick to anger, not addicted to wine, not violent, and not greedy for money;

verses.kjv: But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;
verses.decoded: But loving to welcome guests, loving what is good, selfcontrolled, fair, holy, and disciplined;

verses.kjv: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.
verses.decoded: He must hold firmly to the trustworthy message as it has been taught, so he can encourage others by sound teaching and show those who oppose it that they are wrong.

verses.kjv: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:
verses.decoded: There are many who are rebellious, empty talkers, and deceivers, especially those who belong to the group of circumcision;

verses.kjv: Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre's sake.
verses.decoded: Their mouths must be stopped because they ruin whole families by teaching things they should not, just to get money.

verses.kjv: One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said, The Cretians are alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.
verses.decoded: One of their own prophets said, 'Cretans are always liars, evil animals, and lazy gluttons.'

verses.kjv: This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;
verses.decoded: This statement is true. So, correct them sharply, so they will be strong in their faith;

verses.kjv: Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.
verses.decoded: Not paying attention to Jewish myths and human commands that turn people away from the truth.

verses.kjv: Unto the pure all things are pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.
verses.decoded: To those who are pure, everything is pure; but to those who are corrupted and do not believe, nothing is pure. In fact, their minds and consciences are corrupted.

verses.kjv: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.
verses.decoded: They say they know God, but their actions show they deny him. They are disgusting, disobedient, and unable to do any good work.

verses.kjv: But speak thou the things which become sound doctrine:
verses.decoded: But teach what agrees with healthy teaching.

verses.kjv: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.
verses.decoded: Tell older men to be serious, self-controlled, sensible, faithful, loving, and patient.

verses.kjv: The aged women likewise, that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things;
verses.decoded: In the same way, tell older women to live in a way that shows holiness, not to accuse others falsely, not to drink too much wine, and to teach what is good.

verses.kjv: That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children,
verses.decoded: They should teach younger women to be sensible, to love their husbands, and to love their children.

verses.kjv: To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed.
verses.decoded: They should be careful, pure, keep their homes, be kind, and obey their own husbands, so that God's message is not disrespected.

verses.kjv: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.
verses.decoded: Encourage young men to be self-controlled as well.

verses.kjv: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,
verses.decoded: In everything, show yourself as an example of good works. Teach with honesty, seriousness, and sincerity.

verses.kjv: Sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.
verses.decoded: Use sound speech that cannot be criticized. Then those who oppose you will be ashamed because they have nothing bad to say about you.

verses.kjv: Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters, and to please them well in all things; not answering again;
verses.decoded: Tell slaves to obey their masters and to please them in every way, not arguing back.

verses.kjv: Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.
verses.decoded: Do not steal from them, but show complete honesty, so that the teaching about God our Savior is honored in every way.

verses.kjv: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men,
verses.decoded: God's grace that brings salvation has appeared to all people.

verses.kjv: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;
verses.decoded: It teaches us to reject ungodliness and worldly desires and to live self-controlled, right, and godly lives in this present world.

verses.kjv: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;
verses.decoded: We look forward to the blessed hope—the glorious return of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.
verses.decoded: He gave himself for us to set us free from all sin and to make us his special people who are eager to do good works.

verses.kjv: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise thee.
verses.decoded: Say these things, encourage others, and correct them with full authority. Do not let anyone look down on you.

verses.kjv: Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work,
verses.decoded: Remind them to be obedient to rulers and authorities, to obey government officials, and to be ready to do good at all times.

verses.kjv: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.
verses.decoded: Tell them not to speak badly about anyone, not to fight, but to be gentle and show kindness to everyone.

verses.kjv: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
verses.decoded: We ourselves were once foolish, disobedient, and misled. We followed many desires and pleasures, living with hatred and jealousy, and we hated each other.

verses.kjv: But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared,
verses.decoded: But then God's kindness and love for us appeared,

verses.kjv: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;
verses.decoded: not because of the good things we did, but because of his mercy he saved us by giving us new life through the Holy Spirit,

verses.kjv: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour;
verses.decoded: which he poured out on us generously through Jesus Christ our Savior.

verses.kjv: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
verses.decoded: By his grace we are made right with God and become his heirs, with the hope of eternal life.

verses.kjv: This is a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.
verses.decoded: This saying is trustworthy, and I want you to insist on these things so that those who believe in God will be careful to do good works. These things are good and useful for everyone.

verses.kjv: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
verses.decoded: But avoid foolish arguments, family histories, fights, and arguments about the law, because they are useless and pointless.

verses.kjv: A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject;
verses.decoded: If someone is a troublemaker after you warn them once or twice, reject them.

verses.kjv: Knowing that he that is such is subverted, and sinneth, being condemned of himself.
verses.decoded: You should know that such a person is sinful and condemned by their own judgment.

verses.kjv: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.
verses.decoded: When I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, make every effort to come to me at Nicopolis, because I have decided to spend the winter there.

verses.kjv: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.
verses.decoded: Help Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey, making sure they have everything they need.

verses.kjv: And let our's also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.
verses.decoded: Our people should also learn to do good works to meet the needs of others, so they will not be unproductive.

verses.kjv: All that are with me salute thee. Greet them that love us in the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen. It was written to Titus, ordained the first bishop of the church of the Cretians, from Nicopolis of Macedonia.
verses.decoded: Everyone with me sends you greetings. Greet those who love us in the faith. May God's grace be with you all. Amen.
